card.name: Dating words: dated, predates, undated
card.fires_on: The "date" stem in words about assigning or giving dates, such as dated, well-dated, predates, post-dated, undated and dateline. It is strongest on the ending piece "ated" or "ates" after a prefix.

modes.label: Dated as a verb or adjective
modes.description: Forms of "dated" or "dates" about when a text or fossil was made or how old it is.
modes.example: For the last 20 years we've been looking for good, well-d<<ated>> fossil evidence of that antiquity."

modes.label: Prefixed forms
modes.description: Words like predates, post-dated, undated or antedated, where the stem follows a prefix.
modes.example: the first 71 mottos are post-d<<ated>> forgeries, while the remainder are genuine

card.plain: It marks words built on "date", such as dated, predates and undated, when they describe how old a text or object is.
